product.title: SiS Beta Fuel Gels
product.body_html:
Science In Sport Beta Fuel Energy Gels

High-carbohydrate energy gels built for serious endurance athletes — long-distance cyclists, marathon and ultra runners, and triathletes — operating beyond the two-hour mark where standard 22g gels can't keep up with the body's actual fuel demand. Ideal for race-day fuelling, long training rides, and any session where you need to genuinely hit the 80–120g/hour carb target sustained athletes require.

What separates Beta Fuel from a standard endurance gel comes down to dose density and absorption science. Each gel delivers 40g of carbohydrate — nearly double the 22g standard — in an advanced 1:0.8 maltodextrin-to-fructose ratio. This evolution over the older 2:1 ratio used in most endurance products is research-backed, with studies showing the tighter 1:0.8 ratio improves absorption efficiency at very high intakes (above 90g/hour) where most athletes start hitting GI limits with conventional gels. That's the practical edge: you take fewer gels per hour, get more usable fuel into the muscles, and reduce the stomach distress that wrecks performance late in long sessions.

Science In Sport is a UK-based brand publicly listed on the London Stock Exchange (AIM: SIS) and manufactured to GMP standards. The brand's broader range is widely Informed-Sport certified for elite athletes, with batch-level testing across its performance line. For competing tested-pool athletes in Sri Lanka, always check the individual batch certification on the SiS website; for everyone else, Beta Fuel was developed in collaboration with multiple WorldTour cycling teams and is the official fuelling product used at the highest level of professional endurance sport.

  • 40g of dual-source carbohydrate per gel — nearly double a standard endurance gel, designed for sessions beyond 2 hours
  • Advanced 1:0.8 maltodextrin-to-fructose ratio — improves absorption at very high carb intakes (80–120g/hour) where standard 2:1 gels typically cause GI breakdown
  • Among the best energy gels for endurance athletes doing serious distance — designed specifically for the dose ranges elite athletes actually need
  • Versatile fuelling for cycling, running, and triathlon — works as solid energy gels for cycling on long rides, and equally well as energy gels for swimmers during open-water and pool training blocks
  • Race-tested at WorldTour level — used by professional teams during multi-stage racing where fuelling failure ends events

Pair it with isotonic energy drink mixes or hydration tabs from our energy and hydration range to round out a complete long-session fuelling plan.
